creutz_viray_adapter.even_cover_unramified_condition: Norm_{L_p/Q}(ell) lies in the leading-scalar squareclass; here leading scalar=1, so Norm(ell) must be a square

explicit_family.parameter: d in Q^* and j in {0,1,2,3}
explicit_family.ell_dj: component d in the j-th Q(i) factor of L_p and 1 in the other three factors
explicit_family.subset_extension: for S subset {0,1,2,3}, A_dS=(d,prod_{j in S} f_j(t))_2
explicit_family.complement_identity: A_dS=A_d,S^c on C3_p because prod_j f_j(t)=z^2
